{ "rules": [
    "Model forecasts are too high when prices are bottoming, showing lag on the way up",
    "Sentiment positive (>=0.67) causes model to overshoot current prices, creating near-term reversal bias",
    "When price history shows a clear downtreak, model fails to anticipate the magnitude of the drop",
    "Mean reversion bias: model under-forecasts when prices deviate far from their 18-day mean",
    "Sentiment spikes to 1.00 cause unrealistic optimism in forecasts that reality corrects within 3-5 days",
    "When sentiment alternates between 0.00 and 0.33, model misses the cyclical recovery patterns",
    "Forecast volatility is too low compared to true outcome volatility, especially during sentiment changes"
] }
